family: known-side grammar
target: her name
recommended_fix: 'ਉਸਦੀ ਨਾਂ' — the possessive agrees with ਨਾਂ (masculine): ਉਸਦਾ ਨਾਂ. The ਦੀ looks like a hack to mark 'her'; use the hin his/her explanation intro instead
source: Punjabi possessive ਦਾ/ਦੀ agrees with the possessed noun (Bhatia, Punjabi: A Cognitive-Descriptive Grammar)

family: known-side wording
target: strong

source: Rekhta dictionary: مضبوط = firm, sturdy; hin S0489L01
